offline_answers.query: When should we rollback a release?

evidence.title: Release and rollback playbook (fictional demo)
evidence.quote: Before a release, the release coordinator records the change ticket, tested build identifier, database migration plan, monitoring owner, and rollback owner. Staging smoke tests must pass. The coordinator asks a second engineer to review the checklist before approving the release.

evidence.title: Release and rollback playbook (fictional demo)
evidence.quote: For a customer-facing release, the coordinator posts a start notice, a completion or rollback notice, and the monitoring result in the change ticket. The operations lead receives a daily summary of open releases. This demo assistant cannot approve releases or send notices.

evidence.title: Release and rollback playbook (fictional demo)
evidence.quote: Rollback is considered when the error rate exceeds 2% for five consecutive minutes after a deployment, or when the order creation smoke test fails. The incident commander decides whether to rollback and records the reason in the incident ticket. A rollback is not automatically safe after an irreversible database migration; first consult the migration owner and use the recovery plan.

offline_answers.query: 重大障害のエスカレーションと復旧手順は？

evidence.title: 障害対応ハンドブック（架空のデモ）
evidence.section: 重大度とエスカレーション
evidence.quote: 注文を作成できない全面障害、または顧客データ漏えいの疑いはSEV1の重大障害です。当番エンジニアへ直ちに連絡します。10分以内に応答がなければ運用リーダーへエスカレーションします。運用リーダーが障害対応責任者と連絡担当者を指名します。

offline_answers.query: How are backup restore tests performed?

evidence.title: Data quality and backup handbook (fictional demo)
evidence.quote: Database backups run every night at 02:00 JST. The operations engineer performs a backup restore test in an isolated test environment once a month. Verify record counts and referential integrity, and record elapsed restore time in the backup ticket. Never restore a test backup over the live database.
